evidence: [M] gives a table of per-factor integrated majorants inside the proof of Lemma 13.4: P_j beta'_u g^3 for the stationary-action remainder, P_j(t_{m+1}+g) for the centered determinant remainder, P_j(t_{m+1}+g)^2 for the Haar-Jacobian remainder, P_j Lambda^loop (t+g) g for loop variation, and so on, each at most P'_j b^{-1/2}. [L]'s timing only proves the assembled molecule majorant ('∃ Ξ : Utopia H i ..., Herd H Ξ A (|p x|) l' with 'Rate G L (-(1/2)) q'). stanzaReady prices the cubic, quartic and loop path terms by 'sine p R.cubic (-β)', which is the classical curvature vertex and not the Taylor remainder after the stationary quadratic part. capital prices endpoint receipts. Nearby rate lemmas such as Coat.retreat (rate -1), Coat.annulus (rate -3/2, stated 'BEFORE any pricing of determinant or Gaussian correction') and Itinerary.quoted (a beta cost per vertex for the log/determinant correction) are packaged in [L]'s own rate bookkeeping, and none of them states a row of the table as printed, so the no-match finding stands.

[M] prints, inside the proof of Lemma 13.4, a row-by-row table of integrated majorants: stationary-action remainder P_j beta'_u g^3 <= P'_j b^{-1/2}, centered determinant remainder P_j(t_{m+1}+g), Haar-Jacobian remainder P_j(t_{m+1}+g)^2, loop variation P_j Lambda^loop (t+g) g, etc. [L]'s timing concludes only an aggregate molecule majorant via rate calculus ('Rate G L (-(1/2)) q ∧ Rate G L 0 p ... Herd H Ξ A (|p x|) l'), stanzaReady bounds cubic/quartic/loop path terms with exponents -β, -1 (sine p R.cubic (-β) ...), capital gives per-jump receipt constants, and the determinant/Haar-Jacobian lemmas (YM.Stationary.tribute, Pendant.lean jets) give positivity, identities and jet costs, not the P_j(t+g) or P_j(t+g)^2 rates. No declaration, structure field or proof step states the table's rows, so the no-match stands; nothing indicates a typo.
